preconditions.description: The number of integers n is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.
The integer k is between 2 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**5 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each integer a_i in the list a is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i+1, n) if any(x**k == a[i] * a[j] for x in range(1, int((a[i] * a[j])**(1/k)) + 1)))
postconditions.description: The return value is the count of pairs (i, j) such that 1 <= i < j <= n and there exists an integer x such that a_i * a_j = x^k.
